listings.name: Cafe and Ice Cream Shop
listings.notes: Confidential sale, cross-listed as "Fully Fitted Morningside Cafe, Long Lease, Low Rent" on BusinessesForSale. Closest active listing to the Polwarth/Merchiston corridor.

verification.note: Active listings found on Daltons, Rightbiz and BusinessesForSale; asking £35,000 (leasehold). Address/photos withheld on public listings.

listings.name: Immaculate Coffee Shop (The Bonnie Barista)
listings.notes: The Bonnie Barista, east end of Bruntsfield Place. Commercial kitchen plus large basement. Rent runs well above the £14k Ashley Terrace anchor — Bruntsfield commands a premium. Listing now carries a "PRICE REDUCED – NOW FIXED PRICE" banner.

verification.note: Listing appears active on Rightbiz/Daltons/PrimeLocation at £40,000; evidence shows address and representative images on listing pages.

listings.name: 20-Seat Restaurant
listings.notes: Vegetarian restaurant, retirement sale, new 10-yr lease offered. Offer accepted — "will re-advertise if that changes". Useful size/rent benchmark (20 covers, £12k rent).

verification.note: Rightbiz listing (ID 622797) for the 20-seat Marchmont restaurant is marked "Under Offer"; no asking price shown.

listings.name: Bennitos Cafe
listings.notes: 199 St John's Rd, Corstorphine High Street — decked front seating + rear conservatory. £150k turnover, £25k profit (17%), ~12 years left on lease with option to extend. Agent: DJK Group. The closest real-world validation of the model.

verification.note: Rightbiz listing and local press (Edinburgh Live/News) show Bennitos Cafe still for sale at £40,000; business reported open.

listings.address: 199 St John’s Road, Corstorphine, Edinburgh EH12 7UU

listings.name: The Dower House Cafe
listings.notes: The business closed permanently (final day 19 April 2026; socials marked permanently closed; customers directed to sister cafe The Rosebean). Listing withdrawn — the building belongs to the Corstorphine Trust. Kept as a cautionary comparable.

verification.note: Active estate-agent listings (OnTheMarket/Zoopla/McEwan Fraser) show leasehold offers over £35,000 at 1A Orchardfield Ave.

listings.name: Mirth + Zest Cafe/Gelateria
listings.notes: Formerly Todd's Cafe. Re-offered at reduced price 11/8/2026, vacant and equipped, unlicensed. Offers over £10,000 — the cheapest entry point on the watchlist; cheap for reasons worth investigating.

verification.note: Listing appears live on The Restaurant Agency ("offers over £10,000"); premises at 24 Marchmont Crescent. No definitive photo located.

listings.name: Dessert & Ice Cream Parlour
listings.notes: "Very busy and profitable" per agent Central Business Sales. Same price band as the Morningside cafe — two Morningside options to compare directly.

verification.note: Listing appears active on Daltons/Rightbiz; asking £35,000; premises at 45 Comiston Road, Morningside, Edinburgh.

listings.name: Charming Dessert Shop
listings.notes: £30,000 leasehold on Rightbiz's live Edinburgh café pages — under the £35k–£40k cluster.

verification.note: No active Rightbiz listing found in searches; closest indexed ad (Gumtree) exists but cannot confirm it matches the Rightbiz snapshot or current market status.

listings.name: Tearoom, Brasserie & Creperie
listings.notes: Christie & Co ref 1834, surfaced via Businesses for Sale Scotland. Cross-listed on Rightbiz and PrimeLocation; £15,000/yr rent per the listing.

verification.note: Zoopla/agent listing (Cornerstone) shows leasehold guide price £29,500 for a tearoom on Marchmont Crescent — listing appears active.

listings.name: Contemporary Matcha Tea Shop
listings.notes: Recently refurbished matcha tea house in Stockbridge; turn-key takeaway-focused with scope to expand cafe/takeaway offerings.

verification.note: Listing appears still live — asking £49,000 leasehold on Daltons, Rightbiz and agent listing.

listings.name: Edinburgh City Centre Bubble Tea Business
listings.notes: Stylish, fully refurbished bubble tea business in Edinburgh city centre on Shandwick Place; presented in excellent condition.

verification.note: Listing appears active on Daltons and mirrored on property portals; no evidence of sale/withdrawal found.

listings.name: City Centre Coffee Shop and Sandwich Bar (Ref 1874)
listings.notes: Recently fully renovated coffee shop on Gorgie Road; high footfall location near a local high school and nearby amenities.

listings.name: Class 1 Cafe and Coffee Shop Opportunity (Ref 1690)
listings.notes: Well-fitted, compact Class 1 coffee shop in high-profile central Edinburgh; landlord requires experienced operator with existing business.

verification.note: Listing found live on multiple broker sites (Cornerstone, Rightbiz) at £35,500 for 5 Castle Street; no sold/withdrawn notice found.

listings.name: Edinburgh City Centre Cafe (Turn-key)
listings.notes: Turn-key city-centre cafe in excellent condition; leasehold £50,000; advert states Edinburgh City Centre.

verification.note: Listing still appears active at £50,000 (Daltons/Zoopla); located on Shandwick Place, Edinburgh. No sold/withdrawn notices found.

listings.name: Beautifully Presented Gift and Coffee Shop
listings.notes: Class 1 coffee shop with popular gifts section; 16 years trading; annual rent £19,770 plus VAT.

verification.note: Multiple live listings (Daltons, Rightbiz, BusinessesForSale) show leasehold guide price £70,000 and rent £19,770; appears still on market.
